claim: dbus-launch is the classic per-login-session tool that starts a session bus and exports its address via DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS; its output modes are --sh-syntax/--csh-syntax/--binary-syntax and it binds bus lifetime to the X session via --exit-with-session
stance_target: DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS is set only inside a user login session environment, never for system services
scope_conditions: classic X11 session bus startup; superseded on systemd systems by the dbus user service at $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus
quoted_support: dbus-launch is designed for one-per-login-session use in X clients' startup scripts ... --exit-with-session ... sets DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS in the environment.
